response.query: What quantitative safety constraints (e.g., max weekly % weight loss, capped caloric deficits) will be mandated, and how will both rule-based and learning layers enforce these in real time?
response.answer: Maximum weekly weight loss is capped at 1-2%, and caloric deficits are limited to 500-1000 calories/day. Rule-based systems enforce these limits, while machine learning layers monitor compliance in real time.
